title: Meaningful images
content: Write concise alternative text that communicates the image's purpose or essential information in context. Avoid redundant phrases such as 'image of' when the object can be named directly.

title: Decorative images
content: Decorative images should not add spoken content. Mark them decorative or use empty alternative text only when they convey no information and do not perform a function.

title: Text inside images
content: When readable text in an image is necessary to understand the document, include the essential visible text or its equivalent in the proposed alternative text.

title: Table summaries
content: A table summary should briefly explain the table's subject and organization, especially when relationships are not obvious from individual cells. Preserve the extracted data for human verification.

title: Table headers
content: Accessible tables depend on reliable row and column headers. This project only proposes summaries and does not reconstruct missing table header relationships.

title: Human review
content: Generated captions and summaries are suggestions. A person should verify factual accuracy, context, reading order, and whether the selected PDF structure element is the correct target.
